hooks.command: for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do case "$f" in *.env|*.env.local|*credentials*|*.key|*.pem|*secrets*) echo "BLOCKED: Cannot edit sensitive file: $f"; exit 2;; */reference/*.html) echo "BLOCKED: reference/*.html is the read-only design source of truth: $f"; exit 2;; esac; done

for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f" 2>/dev/null; command -v goimports >/dev/null && goimports -w "$f" 2>/dev/null;; *.ts|*.tsx) (cd /home/sahra/Documents/sahra-perso/gremlyn/gremlyn-dashboard && npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null) || true;; esac; done; exit 0
